editorNote: Sunday's collected headlines center on insider buying at Alibaba, Rocket Lab's lost market value, and a pre-market bid under Alphabet on Gemini talk, with bitcoin and gold both range-bound. Article bodies could not be retrieved, so this edition reports only what the headlines state and offers no view on direction.

stories.headline: Bitcoin struggles to hold above $80,000 as whale transfers send mixed signals, Investing.com says
stories.summary: Investing.com's headline says bitcoin is struggling above $80,000, with large-holder ('whale') transfers pointing in different directions. Only the headline was retrievable, so no further detail is reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin is trading close to the $80,000 level that earlier editions flagged as the bottom of its recent range.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin struggles above $80K as whale transfers signal mixed outlook - Investing.com

stories.headline: Alibaba's CEO and insiders buy more than 1 million shares after the $10 billion share sale, Stocktwits reports
stories.summary: Stocktwits's headline says Alibaba's CEO and other insiders bought over 1 million shares following a $10 billion share sale that sent the stock lower. The article text was not retrievable, so amounts and prices are not reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider purchases following the share sale add to earlier reports of a large Alibaba buy by Jack Ma.

sourceLinks.title: BABA Stock: Alibaba CEO, Insiders Buy Over 1M Shares After $10B Share Sale Sends Shares Lower - Stocktwits

stories.headline: Rocket Lab has erased about $57 billion in value as headwinds mount, Benzinga says
stories.summary: Benzinga's headline says Rocket Lab stock has erased $57 billion in value as headwinds mount. The article body was not retrievable; earlier editions recorded eight straight down sessions and the Neutron debut slipping to 2027.
stories.whyItMatters: The headline puts a dollar figure on a drawdown that earlier editions tracked session by session.

sourceLinks.title: Rocket Lab Stock Erases $57 Billion in Value as Headwinds Mount - Benzinga

stories.headline: Google could release a new Gemini 3.8 Flash model as soon as Wednesday, a report says; GOOGL gains after hours
stories.summary: Stocktwits's headline cites a report that Google could release Gemini 3.8 Flash as soon as Wednesday, and says GOOGL stock gained after hours. The release is reported, not confirmed, in the material retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: A model release rumor coincided with an after-hours gain, a day after earlier editions noted Alphabet stalling ahead of Q3 earnings.

sourceLinks.title: Google Could Release New 3.8 Flash AI Model As Soon As Wednesday, Says Report — GOOGL Stock Gains After-Hours - Stocktwits

stories.headline: US index futures rise as oil falls below $80, with the market focused on Palantir earnings, TradingKey says
stories.summary: TradingKey's pre-market note says the three major US index futures rose, oil fell below $80, and Amazon and Alphabet gained as the market focused on Palantir's earnings.
stories.whyItMatters: Oil under $80 and rising futures set the backdrop for Alphabet's pre-market gain.

sourceLinks.title: 【US Pre-Market】Three Major Index Futures Rise as Oil Falls Below $80; Amazon, Alphabet Gain as Market Focuses on PLTR Earnings - TradingKey

stories.headline: FOREX.com's weekly gold outlook has XAU/USD 'stuck between a rock and a hard place'
stories.summary: FOREX.com's weekly outlook headline describes spot gold as stuck between a rock and a hard place. The body was not retrievable, so levels are not quoted.
stories.whyItMatters: Analysts continue to frame gold as range-bound after its recent selloff.

sourceLinks.title: Gold weekly outlook: XAU/USD remains stuck between a rock and a hard place - FOREX.com

stories.headline: Alphabet plans a Toronto robotaxi service by 2028, Simply Wall Street reports
stories.summary: Simply Wall Street's headline says Alphabet plans a robotaxi service in Toronto by 2028. No further detail was retrievable.
stories.whyItMatters: The headline points to a stated target date for expanding Alphabet's robotaxi business into Canada.

sourceLinks.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Plans Toronto Robotaxi Service By 2028 - Simply Wall Street
